title: Museum of Cham Sculpture, Da Nang

terrainReference.basis: Independent ground sample on the courtyard side of the museum, near the mapped façade. Exact historic thresholds remain approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: The building polygon in OpenStreetMap way 1375028007 sits inside named museum site 302872188. The city tourism authority identifies the original Cham-inspired building and its later gallery expansion.
names: Museum of Cham Sculpture, Da Nang
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped gallery building fixes the long entrance arm and projecting courtyard wings. The two Qualla originals and one exact CC0 supplemental view establish the yellow pilastered walls, dark rectangular bays, entrance steps, and capped terracotta terrace. The named park polygon and separate temple buildings are outside the model.

note: The historic public level is estimated 1.18 meters above the recorded courtyard approach. The lower gallery follows the full mapped perimeter. Rear volume and roof joins are estimates based on the surviving expansion history, photographed terrace and original site grades.
